blocks.zh: 第七至九章：風險評估、最終設計、試運行確效與日常操作
blocks.en: Chapters 7-9: Risk Assessment, Final Design, Commissioning and Qualification, and Routine Operation

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解品質風險管理 (QRM) 如何應用於製程氣體系統，以保障產品品質與病患安全
blocks.en: Understand how quality risk management (QRM) is applied to process gas systems to protect product quality and patient safety

blocks.zh: 掌握 FMEA 風險評估框架：風險識別、風險分析、風險評估與風險控制的四步驟循環
blocks.en: Master the FMEA risk assessment framework: the four-step cycle of risk identification, risk analysis, risk evaluation and risk control

blocks.zh: 了解工程移交文件包 (Engineering Turnover Package, ETOP) 的結構與查核重點
blocks.en: Understand the structure of the Engineering Turnover Package (ETOP) and its key review points

blocks.zh: 熟悉氣體系統試運行 (Commissioning) 與裝置確效/操作確效 (IQ/OQ) 的差異與銜接關係
blocks.en: Understand the differences and the handover between gas system commissioning and installation/operational qualification (IQ/OQ)

blocks.zh: 掌握績效測試 (Performance Testing) 對各使用點 (POU) 氣體品質的驗收標準
blocks.en: Master the acceptance criteria of performance testing for gas quality at each point of use (POU)

blocks.zh: 了解維護與校正計畫在 GMP 合規中的法規要求與最佳實務
blocks.en: Understand the regulatory expectations and best practices for maintenance and calibration programs in GMP compliance

blocks.zh: Chapter 7 — Risk Assessment 風險評估
blocks.en: Chapter 7 — Risk Assessment

blocks.zh: 7.1 Introduction 7.1 簡介
blocks.en: 7.1 Introduction

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — QRM 與製程氣體
blocks.en: Key Concepts — QRM and Process Gases

blocks.zh: 品質風險管理 Quality Risk Management (QRM)：源自 ICH Q9，是一套系統化識別、評估、控制品質風險的方法論。應用於氣體系統時，核心目標是確保每個使用點 (POU) 都能穩定接收符合規格的氣體。
blocks.en: Quality Risk Management (QRM): Derived from ICH Q9, QRM is a systematic methodology for identifying, assessing and controlling quality risks. When applied to gas systems, the core objective is to ensure that every point of use (POU) consistently receives gas that meets specification.

blocks.zh: 風險的三個來源：設計缺陷、安全系統失效、氣體來源問題——這三者涵蓋了整個氣體系統的生命週期。
blocks.en: Three sources of risk: design flaws, failure of safety systems, and problems with the gas source. Together these cover the whole life cycle of a gas system.

blocks.zh: CQA vs CPP 在氣體系統中：CQA 如露點、含油量、微生物計數；CPP 如壓力、流量、溫度。QRM 的本質是保護這些關鍵屬性不受風險影響。
blocks.en: CQAs vs CPPs in gas systems: CQAs include dew point, oil content and microbial counts; CPPs include pressure, flow and temperature. The essence of QRM is to protect these critical attributes from risk.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 把氣體系統的風險評估想像成醫院感染管控計畫 (CCS)：你無法消除所有細菌，但你可以識別高風險區域（手術室 vs 走廊），設定對應的控制措施，並持續監控。製程氣體 QRM 也是如此——不追求零風險，而是將風險降至可接受水準。
blocks.en: Think of gas system risk assessment as a hospital infection control program (CCS): you cannot eliminate every bacterium, but you can identify high-risk areas (operating room vs corridor), set appropriate controls, and keep monitoring. Process gas QRM works the same way: the aim is not zero risk, but reducing risk to an acceptable level.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Note
blocks.en: Key Note

blocks.zh: Table 7.1 的 CQA 列表非常實用：無菌應用 (Sterile) 的微生物計數要求必須符合所服務潔淨室等級的環境監控標準，例如 Grade A 區域的氣體就需達到 Grade A 的粒子規格。這是 CDMO 稽核中常被查核的重點。
blocks.en: The CQA list in Table 7.1 is very practical: for sterile applications, the microbial count requirement must meet the environmental monitoring standard of the cleanroom grade being served. For example, gas used in a Grade A area must meet the Grade A particle specification. This is a frequent focus of CDMO audits.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 若一條氮氣管線同時服務 Grade B 充填區和 Grade C 物料準備區，CQA 規格應以哪個等級為準？理由為何？
blocks.en: If one nitrogen line serves both a Grade B filling area and a Grade C material preparation area, which grade should the CQA specification follow, and why?

blocks.zh: 「完全消除風險既不實際也非必要」這句話的含義是什麼？在 CDMO 的商業環境中如何平衡？
blocks.en: What does the statement "completely eliminating risk is neither practical nor necessary" mean? How do you balance this in a CDMO business environment?

blocks.zh: 7.2 Quality Risk Management for Process Gas Systems 7.2 製程氣體系統品質風險管理
blocks.en: 7.2 Quality Risk Management for Process Gas Systems

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — QRM 的生命週期應用
blocks.en: Key Concepts — Applying QRM Across the Life Cycle

blocks.zh: QRM 不是一次性的文件，而是貫穿氣體系統整個生命週期的持續活動：從 URS 撰寫、設計審查、試運行範圍決定、校正頻率設定、預防性維護計畫，到例行監控頻率調整，每個環節都由風險評估結果驅動。
blocks.en: QRM is not a one-time document but an ongoing activity across the entire life cycle of the gas system: from writing the URS, design review, deciding the scope of commissioning, setting calibration frequencies and the preventive maintenance program, to adjusting routine monitoring frequency. Every step is driven by the results of the risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 資源投入與風險成比例
blocks.en: Key Note — Effort Proportional to Risk

blocks.zh: 「投入的心力應與業務影響成比例」——這句話對 CDMO 特別重要。直接接觸產品的 Grade A 氣體系統，比工廠公用動力用壓縮空氣值得投入更多 QRM 資源。不要在低風險系統上過度確效，也不要在高風險系統上省略關鍵步驟。
blocks.en: "Effort should be proportional to the business impact" is especially important for a CDMO. A Grade A gas system in direct contact with product deserves more QRM resources than plant utility compressed air. Do not over-validate low-risk systems, and do not skip critical steps on high-risk systems.

blocks.zh: QRM 就像醫院的「分類系統 (Triage)」：急診室依病情嚴重程度分配醫療資源，而不是每個病人都用最高規格治療。氣體系統 QRM 也是如此——讓高風險的環節獲得充足驗證資源，低風險環節減少不必要的確效活動。
blocks.en: QRM is like hospital triage: the emergency room allocates medical resources according to the severity of the condition, rather than giving every patient the highest level of treatment. Gas system QRM works the same way: give high-risk areas sufficient verification resources and reduce unnecessary qualification activity in low-risk areas.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 CDMO Application
blocks.en: CDMO Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 接受新客戶委託時，常需要評估既有氣體系統是否適用於客戶產品。QRM 結果直接影響：是否需要追加確效測試、哪些 POU 需要加裝 POU 過濾器、預防性維護計畫是否需要調整。這些決策若有風險評估支撐，面對客戶稽核時更具說服力。
blocks.en: When a CDMO takes on a new client, it often needs to assess whether the existing gas systems are suitable for the client's product. QRM results directly affect whether additional qualification testing is needed, which POUs need POU filters added, and whether the preventive maintenance program needs adjusting. Decisions supported by a risk assessment are more convincing in client audits.

blocks.zh: 7.3 Risk Assessment Process — 風險評估流程
blocks.en: 7.3 Risk Assessment Process

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — FMEA 三要素
blocks.en: Key Concepts — The Three Elements of FMEA

blocks.zh: 氣體系統風險評估通常採用 FMEA (失效模式與影響分析) 架構，三個評分維度：
blocks.en: Gas system risk assessments usually use an FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) framework with three scoring dimensions:

blocks.zh: 嚴重性 Severity (S)：失效後果對產品品質/病患安全的影響程度
blocks.en: Severity (S): the impact of the failure consequence on product quality and patient safety

blocks.zh: 發生可能性 Occurrence (O)：在現有控制措施下，風險事件發生的機率
blocks.en: Occurrence (O): the probability that the risk event occurs under the existing controls

blocks.zh: 可偵測性 Detection (D)：在危害發生後，被偵測到的難易度
blocks.en: Detection (D): how easily the hazard is detected once it has occurred

blocks.zh: 風險優先數 (RPN) = S × O × D，用於排序需要優先控制的失效模式。
blocks.en: Risk Priority Number (RPN) = S × O × D, used to rank the failure modes that need priority control.

blocks.zh: 典型壓縮空氣系統 FMEA 範例
blocks.en: Typical FMEA Example for a Compressed Air System

blocks.zh:
失效模式          S  O  D  RPN  控制措施
壓縮機失效        4  2  2   16  備用機組+壓力警報
過濾器堵塞        3  3  2   18  差壓監控+定期更換
水分突破          4  2  1    8  露點連續監測+高警報
N₂中混入O₂        5  1  1    5  止回閥+氣體分析儀
油蒸氣污染        4  2  2   16  無油壓縮機+活性碳過濾
微生物污染        4  1  3   12  POU過濾器+微生物監控

S/O/D 評分 1-5（5=最高嚴重/最常發生/最難偵測）
blocks.en:
Failure mode          S  O  D  RPN  Control measure
Compressor failure    4  2  2   16  Standby unit + pressure alarm
Filter blockage       3  3  2   18  Differential pressure monitoring + scheduled replacement
Moisture breakthrough 4  2  1    8  Continuous dew point monitoring + high alarm
O₂ ingress into N₂    5  1  1    5  Check valve + gas analyzer
Oil vapor contamination 4 2  2   16  Oil-free compressor + activated carbon filtration
Microbial contamination 4 1  3   12  POU filter + microbial monitoring

S/O/D scored 1-5 (5 = most severe / most frequent / hardest to detect)

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 氣體混用風險
blocks.en: Key Note — Gas Mix-up Risk

blocks.zh: Process gas mix-up（氣體混用）是評分嚴重性最高的風險之一：若氧氣容器錯接至氮氣分配系統，可能造成爆炸或產品氧化。控制措施包括：使用不同接頭規格、明確的顏色標示、接管前的 ID 測試程序，以及最終的 GC 分析確認。這在 CDMO 環境中是一個必須寫進 SOP 的管控項目。
blocks.en: Process gas mix-up is among the highest-severity risks: if an oxygen container is wrongly connected to a nitrogen distribution system, it can cause an explosion or product oxidation. Controls include different connector specifications, clear color coding, an ID test procedure before connection, and final confirmation by GC analysis. In a CDMO environment this is a control item that must be written into an SOP.

blocks.zh: 三步驟風險評估（識別→分析→評估）就像醫院的病例診斷程序：先列出所有可能症狀（識別），評估每個症狀的嚴重程度與發生機率（分析），最後決定是否達到需要治療的門檻（評估）。不是每個風險都需要立即處置，但每個高 RPN 的風險都必須有對應的控制措施。
blocks.en: The three-step risk assessment (identification, analysis, evaluation) is like a hospital diagnostic procedure: first list all possible symptoms (identification), assess the severity and likelihood of each (analysis), and finally decide whether it reaches the threshold for treatment (evaluation). Not every risk needs immediate action, but every high-RPN risk must have a corresponding control measure.

blocks.zh: 在進行既有（legacy）氣體系統的風險評估時，歷史數據能發揮什麼作用？相比新系統，評估範圍會如何調整？
blocks.en: When performing a risk assessment of an existing (legacy) gas system, what role can historical data play? How does the scope of the assessment differ compared with a new system?

blocks.zh: 「逆流 (reverse flow)」風險在什麼情況下最容易發生？應採取哪些設計控制措施？
blocks.en: Under what circumstances is "reverse flow" most likely to occur? What design controls should be applied?

blocks.zh: 7.4–7.6 Risk Control, Communication & Review 7.4–7.6 風險控制、溝通與審查
blocks.en: 7.4-7.6 Risk Control, Communication & Review

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 風險控制的層級優先順序
blocks.en: Key Concepts — Hierarchy of Risk Controls

blocks.zh: ISPE 明確規定風險控制的優先順序：
blocks.en: ISPE explicitly specifies the order of priority for risk controls:

blocks.zh: 設計變更（最優先）：從根本消除風險來源，例如改用無油壓縮機消除油污染風險
blocks.en: Design change (highest priority): eliminate the source of risk at its root, for example switching to an oil-free compressor to eliminate the risk of oil contamination

blocks.zh: 程序控制（次之）：透過 SOP、人員訓練、警報設定等軟性控制降低風險
blocks.en: Procedural control (second): reduce risk through "soft" controls such as SOPs, personnel training and alarm settings

blocks.zh: 這個優先順序與 EU GMP Annex 1 的污染控制策略 (CCS) 設計原則完全一致。
blocks.en: This order of priority is fully consistent with the design principles of the contamination control strategy (CCS) in EU GMP Annex 1.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 風險評估的前提條件
blocks.en: Key Note — Prerequisite for the Risk Assessment

blocks.zh: 關鍵洞察：「風險評估分數假設控制措施已到位並運作中」——這意味著若驗收報告批准了風險評估，就等同於確認控制措施確實在運行。這是 CDMO 在設施稽核中必須能夠舉證的：你的 RPN 分數有多低，你的控制措施就需要有多健全的執行證據。
blocks.en: Key insight: "The risk assessment scores assume that the controls are in place and operating." This means that approving the risk assessment in the acceptance report is equivalent to confirming that the controls are actually running. A CDMO must be able to demonstrate this in a facility audit: the lower your RPN scores, the more robust the evidence of execution your controls require.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 風險接受 vs 風險降低
blocks.en: Analogy — Risk Acceptance vs Risk Reduction

blocks.zh: 風險接受就像保險決策：你不會為了每一個可能的意外都買保險，但對高金額損失的風險（如氣體汙染批次報廢），你一定要有明確的保障措施。「被動接受」（從未定義殘餘風險）是不可接受的做法，就像開車不買任何保險。
blocks.en: Risk acceptance is like an insurance decision: you do not buy insurance for every possible accident, but for high-value loss risks (such as a batch scrapped because of gas contamination) you must have clear safeguards. "Passive acceptance" (never defining the residual risk) is not acceptable, like driving without any insurance.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — 定期風險審查的觸發條件
blocks.en: CDMO Application — Triggers for Periodic Risk Review

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務中，以下事件應觸發風險評估審查：
blocks.en: In CDMO practice, the following events should trigger a review of the risk assessment:

blocks.zh: 系統改建或管線變更（變更控制啟動）
blocks.en: System modification or piping change (change control initiated)

blocks.zh: 新產品引入，改變了 POU 的使用目的
blocks.en: Introduction of a new product that changes the intended use of a POU

blocks.zh: 偏差事件或重複性 OOS 結果
blocks.en: Deviation events or repeated OOS results

blocks.zh: 定期（如每年）審查週期到期
blocks.en: The periodic (for example annual) review cycle is due

blocks.zh: 監管機構視察後的改善要求
blocks.en: Improvement requirements following a regulatory inspection

blocks.zh: 若為了降低壓縮空氣含油風險而加裝額外過濾器，可能引入什麼新風險？
blocks.en: If an additional filter is installed to reduce the risk of oil in compressed air, what new risks might it introduce?

blocks.zh: 風險評估報告如何幫助定義系統確效 (Qualification) 的範圍？請舉一個具體例子。
blocks.en: How does the risk assessment report help define the scope of system qualification? Give a specific example.

blocks.zh: Chapter 8 — Final Design, Commissioning & Qualification 最終設計、試運行與確效
blocks.en: Chapter 8 — Final Design, Commissioning & Qualification

blocks.zh: 8.1–8.2 Introduction & Engineering Turnover Package (ETOP) 8.1–8.2 簡介與工程移交文件包 (ETOP)
blocks.en: 8.1-8.2 Introduction & Engineering Turnover Package (ETOP)

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — ETOP 的角色
blocks.en: Key Concepts — The Role of the ETOP

blocks.zh: 工程移交文件包 Engineering Turnover Package (ETOP) 是從「施工完成」到「確效開始」的橋樑文件。它的三個組成部分對應三個不同的責任方：
blocks.en: The Engineering Turnover Package (ETOP) is the bridge document between "construction complete" and "start of qualification". Its three components correspond to three different responsible parties:

blocks.zh: 施工管理者：確保設計意圖被正確執行
blocks.en: Construction manager: ensures the design intent is correctly implemented

blocks.zh: 安裝承包商：提供設備安裝的完整證明文件
blocks.en: Installation contractor: provides complete documentation of the equipment installation

blocks.zh: 試運行團隊：記錄系統初始性能基準
blocks.en: Commissioning team: records the initial performance baseline of the system

blocks.zh: ETOP 是 IQ 確效的主要資料來源——確效工程師從這裡取得圖面、設備清單、校正記錄，與現場實際狀況進行比對。
blocks.en: The ETOP is the main source of data for IQ: the validation engineer obtains drawings, equipment lists and calibration records from it and compares them with the actual site conditions.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 常見稽核發現
blocks.en: Key Note — Common Audit Findings

blocks.zh: CDMO 在稽核中最常被查到的 ETOP 問題：
blocks.en: The most common ETOP problems found in CDMO audits:

blocks.zh: P&ID 缺失或版本不一致："As-built" 圖面與實際管路不符，尤其是後期的系統改建未更新 P&ID
blocks.en: Missing or inconsistent P&ID versions: the "as-built" drawing does not match the actual piping, especially when later system modifications did not update the P&ID

blocks.zh: 校正紀錄缺漏：儀表安裝合格證明或出廠校正書未歸入 ETOP
blocks.en: Missing calibration records: instrument installation acceptance certificates or factory calibration certificates were not filed in the ETOP

blocks.zh: 焊接紀錄不完整：高純度氣體管路的焊工資格證書遺失
blocks.en: Incomplete welding records: welder qualification certificates for high-purity gas piping are missing

blocks.zh: Punch list 未完全關閉：遺留的待改善項目在移交時未被記錄
blocks.en: Punch list not fully closed: remaining items for improvement were not recorded at handover

blocks.zh: ETOP 就像新房交屋時的驗屋報告：建商必須提供完整的施工圖、材料規格書、水電管線圖，以及所有試驗合格證明。沒有完整的交屋文件，就算房子蓋好了，你也不知道裡面埋的是什麼材質的管線。氣體系統的 ETOP 邏輯完全相同——它是你對系統「來歷清白」的法律憑證。
blocks.en: The ETOP is like the inspection report when a new house is handed over: the builder must provide complete construction drawings, material specifications, plumbing and electrical diagrams, and all test certificates. Without complete handover documents, even if the house is built, you do not know what material the pipes buried inside are made of. The ETOP for a gas system follows exactly the same logic: it is your legal evidence that the system has a clean provenance.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 氣體系統 vs 水系統的差異
blocks.en: Key Note — Differences Between Gas Systems and Water Systems

blocks.zh: ISPE 明確指出：氣體系統確效不需要測試排放坡度、死角、材質表面粗糙度等水系統的常規項目。這是因為氣體不會積水，微生物無法在乾燥氣體中繁殖。CDMO 的確效協議書不應盲目套用水系統的 IQ 查核清單於氣體系統。
blocks.en: ISPE explicitly states that qualification of gas systems does not need to test drainage slope, dead legs, surface roughness of materials or other routine items of water systems. This is because gas does not collect water, and microorganisms cannot multiply in dry gas. A CDMO's qualification protocol should not blindly apply a water system IQ checklist to a gas system.

blocks.zh: 若在安裝確效 (IQ) 期間發現 P&ID 與實際安裝有差異，應如何處理？這會影響確效進度嗎？
blocks.en: If a difference between the P&ID and the actual installation is found during installation qualification (IQ), how should it be handled? Will this affect the qualification schedule?

blocks.zh: ETOP 中的「Commissioning Section」與正式的 IQ/OQ 文件有何不同？哪些資料可以直接引用？
blocks.en: How does the "Commissioning Section" in the ETOP differ from formal IQ/OQ documents? Which data can be referenced directly?

blocks.zh: 8.3 Commissioning 試運行
blocks.en: 8.3 Commissioning

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — Commissioning vs Qualification 的分界
blocks.en: Key Concepts — The Boundary Between Commissioning and Qualification

blocks.zh: 這是製藥工程中一個關鍵的概念邊界：
blocks.en: This is a key conceptual boundary in pharmaceutical engineering:

blocks.zh: 試運行 Commissioning：由工程部門主導，依 GEP 執行，證明系統按設計安裝與運作。不需要 QA 事前批准。
blocks.en: Commissioning: led by the engineering department and performed according to GEP, it demonstrates that the system is installed and operates as designed. QA pre-approval is not required.

blocks.zh: 確效 Qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ)：由品保/確效部門主導，依 GMP 法規要求執行，需要 QA 事前批准協議書。
blocks.en: Qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ): led by QA/validation and performed according to GMP requirements, it requires QA pre-approval of the protocol.

blocks.zh: ISPE 的「Science and Risk-Based Approach」(ASTM E2500) 框架允許充分利用試運行資料支援確效，避免重複測試，節省成本與時間。
blocks.en: ISPE's "Science and Risk-Based Approach" (ASTM E2500) framework allows commissioning data to be fully leveraged to support qualification, avoiding duplicate testing and saving cost and time.

blocks.zh: 試運行就像新車出廠前的品管測試：工廠測試煞車、引擎、電氣系統，確保一切按規格運作。而確效（GMP 環境）則像醫療器材上市前的臨床驗證：在實際使用環境中，依照預定規格進行有文件記錄的驗證，最終由品保部門批准放行。
blocks.en: Commissioning is like the quality control test before a new car leaves the factory: the factory tests the brakes, engine and electrical system to ensure everything works to specification. Qualification (in a GMP environment) is like the clinical validation of a medical device before launch: documented verification against predefined specifications in the actual use environment, with final approval and release by the quality unit.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 壓力測試與清洗紀錄
blocks.en: Key Note — Pressure Testing and Purging Records

blocks.zh: 管路壓力測試 (pressure testing) 與吹掃/清洗紀錄 (purging) 是試運行的核心項目。對於高純度氣體系統：
blocks.en: Pipe pressure testing and purging records are core commissioning items. For high-purity gas systems:

blocks.zh: 壓力測試通常在 1.5 倍最高工作壓力下進行，確認管路完整性
blocks.en: Pressure testing is usually performed at 1.5 times the maximum working pressure to confirm piping integrity

blocks.zh: 系統在性能測試前必須充分吹掃，以去除施工殘留物（金屬碎屑、焊接殘渣）
blocks.en: The system must be thoroughly purged before performance testing to remove construction residues (metal chips, welding residue)

blocks.zh: 鈍化 (passivation) 紀錄適用於不鏽鋼高純度氣體管路
blocks.en: Passivation records apply to stainless steel high-purity gas piping

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 專案管理角度
blocks.en: CDMO Application — Project Management Perspective

blocks.zh: CDMO 在承接新廠建置或擴產項目時，建議在合約中明確規定 ETOP 的交付要求與時間點，並指定哪些試運行數據將被納入確效協議引用。這樣可以有效縮短從設施完工到第一批產品放行的時間軸。
blocks.en: When a CDMO undertakes a new plant build or capacity expansion project, it is advisable to specify the ETOP delivery requirements and timing clearly in the contract, and to designate which commissioning data will be referenced in the qualification protocols. This can effectively shorten the timeline from facility completion to release of the first product batch.

blocks.zh: 8.4 Installation and Operational Tests (IQ/OQ) 裝置確效與操作確效
blocks.en: 8.4 Installation and Operational Tests (IQ/OQ)

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — P&ID Walk Down 的意義
blocks.en: Key Concepts — The Significance of the P&ID Walk Down

blocks.zh: P&ID 現場查核 (Walk Down) 是 IQ 的核心活動之一。其目的是確認現場實際安裝與設計圖面完全一致，並將所有差異記錄在「紅線圖」上，最終決定這些差異是否可接受，或需要列入 Punch List 要求承包商改正。
blocks.en: The P&ID walk down is one of the core activities of IQ. Its purpose is to confirm that the actual field installation fully matches the design drawings, record all differences on a "redline drawing", and finally decide whether these differences are acceptable or need to be added to the punch list for the contractor to correct.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，IQ 確效協議通常引用試運行期間完成的 P&ID walk down 記錄，而不需要重複執行相同的步驟——這正是科學風險導向確效的效益。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, the IQ protocol usually references the P&ID walk down records completed during commissioning, without repeating the same steps. This is exactly the benefit of science and risk-based qualification.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — Punch List 的管理
blocks.en: Key Note — Managing the Punch List

blocks.zh: Punch List 是一份「待解決問題清單」。確效的前提是所有影響系統功能的 Punch List 項目必須關閉 (closed out)。允許保留的 open items 通常只限於對系統性能無影響的外觀或行政性問題，且必須有書面的風險評估支撐。稽核中常見的問題是確效報告批准時仍有未關閉的重要 Punch List 項目。
blocks.en: The punch list is a "list of issues to be resolved". As a prerequisite for qualification, all punch list items that affect system function must be closed out. Open items that may remain are usually limited to cosmetic or administrative issues with no effect on system performance, and these must be supported by a written risk assessment. A common audit finding is that important punch list items are still open when the qualification report is approved.

blocks.zh: IQ 查核清單重點項目
blocks.en: Key Items of the IQ Checklist

blocks.zh:
裝置確效 (IQ) 查核內容：
□ P&ID walk down 完成並簽署
□ 設備清單與現場實物核對
□ 儀表清單與校正憑證核對
□ 材質合格證明 (Mill Certificates)
□ 焊接紀錄與焊工資格
□ 管路壓力測試紀錄
□ 吹掃/清洗紀錄
□ Punch List 全數關閉
□ SOP 與維護手冊到位
□ 人員訓練記錄到位
blocks.en:
Installation qualification (IQ) checklist:
□ P&ID walk down completed and signed
□ Equipment list verified against physical equipment on site
□ Instrument list verified against calibration certificates
□ Material certificates (Mill Certificates)
□ Welding records and welder qualifications
□ Piping pressure test records
□ Purging records
□ Punch list fully closed
□ SOPs and maintenance manuals in place
□ Training records in place

blocks.zh: P&ID walk down 發現某個安全閥的位置與圖面不符，但功能相同。這算不算需要列入 Punch List 的問題？
blocks.en: The P&ID walk down finds that the position of a safety valve does not match the drawing, although the function is the same. Does this need to be added to the punch list?

blocks.zh: CAGI 認證對壓縮機的意義是什麼？為何這可能需要作為規格要求的一部分？
blocks.en: What is the significance of CAGI certification for compressors? Why might it need to be part of the specification requirements?

blocks.zh: 8.5–8.6 Performance Testing & Acceptance and Release 性能測試與放行
blocks.en: 8.5-8.6 Performance Testing & Acceptance and Release

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — OQ 與 PQ 的銜接
blocks.en: Key Concepts — The Link Between OQ and PQ

blocks.zh: 氣體系統的「Performance Testing」相當於傳統確效架構中的 OQ（操作確效） 和 PQ（性能確效） 的組合：
blocks.en: "Performance Testing" of a gas system is equivalent to a combination of OQ (operational qualification) and PQ (performance qualification) in the traditional qualification framework:

blocks.zh: 類似 OQ：確認系統在規格範圍內運作，如壓力控制、流量、警報功能
blocks.en: OQ-like: confirms the system operates within specification, such as pressure control, flow and alarm functions

blocks.zh: 類似 PQ：在各 POU 採樣確認氣體品質符合規格（露點、粒子、微生物、油含量）
blocks.en: PQ-like: samples at each POU to confirm gas quality meets specification (dew point, particles, microorganisms, oil content)

blocks.zh: 「至少三次連續採樣」的要求是統計可信度的最低標準，對於新系統或高風險應用，應考慮增加取樣次數。
blocks.en: The requirement of "at least three consecutive samples" is the minimum standard for statistical confidence; for new systems or high-risk applications, consider increasing the number of samples.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — OQ 失敗情境管理
blocks.en: Key Note — Managing OQ Failure Scenarios

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務中，若性能測試出現 OOS 結果（如 N₂ 沖洗後 O₂ 分析儀讀值超標），標準調查流程：
blocks.en: In CDMO practice, if performance testing produces an OOS result (for example the O₂ analyzer reading exceeds the limit after an N₂ purge), the standard investigation process is:

blocks.zh: 確認儀器校正狀態是否正常（排除量測誤差）
blocks.en: Confirm that the instrument calibration status is normal (to rule out measurement error)

blocks.zh: 延長沖洗時間並重新取樣
blocks.en: Extend the purge time and resample

blocks.zh: 檢查接頭與閥件的密封完整性（排除外氣滲入）
blocks.en: Check the sealing integrity of fittings and valves (to rule out ingress of outside air)

blocks.zh: 確認系統清洗/吹掃紀錄是否充分
blocks.en: Confirm that the system purging records are adequate

blocks.zh: 評估是否需要調整 OQ 接受標準（需有科學依據）
blocks.en: Assess whether the OQ acceptance criteria need adjusting (this requires a scientific basis)

blocks.zh: 所有調查步驟必須書面記錄
blocks.en: All investigation steps must be documented in writing

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 移交後的 QA 管控
blocks.en: Key Note — QA Control After Handover

blocks.zh: 確效報告核准後，系統正式移交至運營部門，所有後續的：系統修改、儀表校正窗口變更、過濾器規格變更、操作參數調整，都必須通過 正式變更管控 (Change Control) 處理。這是稽核查核的高頻區域，特別是「系統在確效後有沒有被修改但沒有通知 QA」的問題。
blocks.en: After the qualification report is approved, the system is formally handed over to operations. All subsequent system modifications, changes to instrument calibration windows, changes to filter specifications and adjustments of operating parameters must be handled through formal Change Control. This is a frequent audit focus area, especially the question of whether "the system was modified after qualification without notifying QA".

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — 確效報告的批准結構
blocks.en: CDMO Application — Approval Structure of the Qualification Report

blocks.zh: 標準的確效摘要報告批准三方：系統負責人 (System Owner)、工程部門代表、品保/確效代表。三方簽署等同於正式宣告系統符合 GMP 用途。CDMO 應確保批准層級與客戶期望一致，尤其是委外客戶提供確效策略時。
blocks.en: A standard qualification summary report is approved by three parties: the System Owner, an engineering representative, and a QA/validation representative. The three signatures amount to a formal declaration that the system is fit for GMP use. A CDMO should ensure the approval level is consistent with client expectations, especially when an outsourcing client provides the qualification strategy.

blocks.zh: 若壓縮空氣系統有 20 個 POU，是否每個都需要取樣三次？或者可以依風險分層選取代表性 POU？
blocks.en: If a compressed air system has 20 POUs, does each one need to be sampled three times? Or can representative POUs be selected using a risk-based stratification?

blocks.zh: 績效測試通過後，監控頻率可以降低的依據是什麼？需要什麼統計工具或數據量支撐？
blocks.en: After performance testing is passed, what is the basis for reducing monitoring frequency? What statistical tools or volume of data are needed to support it?

blocks.zh: Chapter 9 — Operation and Maintenance 日常操作與維護
blocks.en: Chapter 9 — Operation and Maintenance

blocks.zh: 9.1 Maintenance 維護管理
blocks.en: 9.1 Maintenance

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 預防性維護 (PM) 的法規依據
blocks.en: Key Concepts — The Regulatory Basis for Preventive Maintenance (PM)

blocks.zh: EU GMP (Eudralex Vol.4 Annex 1) 和 FDA 21 CFR 211.68 都要求對製藥生產設備維護設備日誌 (equipment log)。氣體系統屬於「直接影響製程的公用設施」，因此其預防性維護計畫必須：
blocks.en: EU GMP (EudraLex Vol. 4, Annex 1) and FDA 21 CFR 211.68 both require an equipment log to be kept for the maintenance of pharmaceutical manufacturing equipment. A gas system is a "utility that directly affects the process", so its preventive maintenance program must:

blocks.zh: 有書面 PM 程序 (SOP)
blocks.en: Have a written PM procedure (SOP)

blocks.zh: 依時程執行並有執行紀錄
blocks.en: Be executed on schedule with execution records

blocks.zh: PM 項目的設定有科學/風險依據
blocks.en: Have a scientific/risk-based rationale for setting PM items

blocks.zh: 任何 PM 項目的更動需通過變更管控
blocks.en: Route any change to PM items through change control

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 過濾器更換的變更管控
blocks.en: Key Note — Change Control for Filter Replacement

blocks.zh: POU 過濾器是 GMP 與非 GMP 氣體系統之間的關鍵屏障。過濾器規格（孔徑、材質、廠商）的任何變更都必須經過正式的變更管控 (Change Control) 處理，包括：
blocks.en: POU filters are the critical barrier between GMP and non-GMP gas systems. Any change to filter specifications (pore size, material, supplier) must go through formal Change Control, including:

blocks.zh: 影響評估（是否影響 CQA？）
blocks.en: Impact assessment (does it affect CQAs?)

blocks.zh: 必要時重新進行過濾完整性測試
blocks.en: Repeating the filter integrity test where necessary

blocks.zh: 更新 PM 程序與設備清單
blocks.en: Updating the PM procedure and equipment list

blocks.zh: 通知下游使用部門
blocks.en: Notifying downstream user departments

blocks.zh: 「單純更換相同規格的消耗品」通常不需要完整的變更管控，但需要有清楚的材料核准清單 (Approved Supplier List) 定義什麼是「相同規格」。
blocks.en: "Simply replacing a consumable with the same specification" usually does not require full change control, but a clear Approved Supplier List is needed to define what "the same specification" means.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 差壓不是唯一的換濾指標
blocks.en: Key Note — Differential Pressure Is Not the Only Indicator for Filter Change

blocks.zh: ISPE 明確指出：不應單獨用差壓作為換濾指標，除非差壓是在已知流量條件下量測的。原因：若流量降低（例如實際使用量減少），差壓也會降低，可能給出「過濾器狀態良好」的假象，即使過濾器已達壽命終點。建議結合時間基準 (time-based) 和差壓雙重標準執行換濾計畫。
blocks.en: ISPE explicitly states that differential pressure should not be used alone as the filter change indicator unless it is measured under known flow conditions. The reason: if flow decreases (for example because actual consumption falls), differential pressure also falls, which may give a false impression that the filter is in good condition even though it has reached the end of its life. It is recommended to combine time-based and differential pressure criteria in the filter change program.

blocks.zh: 系統趨勢監控的意義
blocks.en: The Significance of System Trend Monitoring

blocks.zh:
監控趨勢項目      異常訊號         可能原因
油耗增加          超出基準 30%+    壓縮機密封件磨損
電力消耗上升      持續增加趨勢     壓縮機效率降低/過濾器堵塞
氣體消耗異常      突然大幅增加     系統洩漏
啟停次數增加      超出設計頻率     壓縮機容量不足/洩漏
振動值上升        超出基準值       軸承磨損/機械失衡

趨勢監控 = 預防性維護的眼睛
早期發現 → 計畫性停機維修
晚期發現 → 緊急停機 + 潛在生產損失
blocks.en:
Monitored trend item     Abnormal signal          Possible cause
Oil consumption increase  Exceeds baseline by 30%+ Worn compressor seals
Power consumption rise    Continuing upward trend  Reduced compressor efficiency / blocked filter
Abnormal gas consumption  Sudden large increase    System leak
Start/stop count increase Exceeds design frequency Insufficient compressor capacity / leak
Vibration rise            Exceeds baseline value   Bearing wear / mechanical imbalance

Trend monitoring = the eyes of preventive maintenance
Early detection → planned shutdown for repair
Late detection → emergency shutdown + potential production loss

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 備件管理
blocks.en: CDMO Application — Spare Parts Management

blocks.zh: 備件庫存策略對 CDMO 的生產連續性至關重要。POU 過濾器、露點感應器的更換元件、壓縮機密封套件——這些「關鍵備件」的交期若超過 4–6 週，就應納入安全庫存計畫，並定期審查使用歷史更新再訂購點 (reorder point)。避免因備件斷料造成計畫外的氣體系統停機。
blocks.en: A spare parts inventory strategy is essential to production continuity at a CDMO. For "critical spares" such as POU filters, replacement elements for dew point sensors and compressor seal kits, if the lead time exceeds 4-6 weeks they should be included in a safety stock program, and the reorder point should be updated periodically based on usage history. This avoids unplanned gas system downtime caused by spare part stock-outs.

blocks.zh: 若一個工廠的壓縮空氣系統振動監控數值在過去 30 天持續上升 15%，應該如何回應？需要啟動哪些程序？
blocks.en: If the vibration monitoring value of a plant's compressed air system keeps rising by 15% over the past 30 days, how should you respond? Which procedures need to be initiated?

blocks.zh: 備用壓縮機（standby）的自動切換功能，在維護計畫中應如何驗證？多久驗證一次比較合適？
blocks.en: How should the automatic changeover function of a standby compressor be verified in the maintenance program? How often is appropriate?

blocks.zh: 9.2 Calibration 校正管理
blocks.en: 9.2 Calibration

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 風險導向的校正策略
blocks.en: Key Concepts — Risk-Based Calibration Strategy

blocks.zh: ISPE 強調：校正策略必須由風險評估結果驅動。實務上，氣體系統儀表依重要性分層：
blocks.en: ISPE emphasizes that the calibration strategy must be driven by the results of the risk assessment. In practice, gas system instruments are tiered by criticality:

blocks.zh: 產品關鍵 (Product Critical)：POU 露點感應器、O₂ 分析儀、微生物取樣設備 → 嚴格校正頻率（如每 6 個月）+ 校正失敗即啟動調查
blocks.en: Product Critical: POU dew point sensors, O₂ analyzers, microbial sampling equipment → strict calibration frequency (for example every 6 months) + investigation initiated on any calibration failure

blocks.zh: 製程關鍵 (Process Critical)：系統壓力感應器、流量計 → 標準校正週期（如每年）
blocks.en: Process Critical: system pressure sensors, flow meters → standard calibration interval (for example annually)

blocks.zh: 非關鍵 (Non-Critical)：工程用壓力錶、非 GMP 區域儀表 → 延長校正間隔或目視檢查替代
blocks.en: Non-Critical: engineering pressure gauges, instruments in non-GMP areas → extended calibration interval or replacement by visual inspection

blocks.zh: 校正策略就像定期健康檢查的頻率：心臟病高風險患者每 3 個月一次、一般人每年一次、年輕健康的人可能 2–3 年一次。你不會讓所有人都做一樣頻率的檢查，而是依據「若這個指標出錯，後果有多嚴重？」來決定檢查頻率。氣體系統儀表校正邏輯完全相同。
blocks.en: A calibration strategy is like the frequency of routine health checkups: every 3 months for patients at high risk of heart disease, once a year for the average person, perhaps once every 2-3 years for young, healthy people. You do not give everyone the same frequency of checkups; you decide based on "how serious are the consequences if this indicator is wrong?" The logic of gas system instrument calibration is exactly the same.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 校正失敗的影響評估
blocks.en: Key Note — Impact Assessment of Calibration Failure

blocks.zh: 當一個關鍵儀表校正失敗（讀值超出允許誤差），CDMO 必須：
blocks.en: When a critical instrument fails calibration (the reading exceeds the permitted tolerance), the CDMO must:

blocks.zh: 立即隔離該儀表，避免繼續使用錯誤讀值做出決策
blocks.en: Immediately isolate the instrument to avoid continuing to make decisions based on incorrect readings

blocks.zh: 評估在上次校正合格日期至今，使用該儀表讀值做出的所有放行決定
blocks.en: Assess all release decisions made using that instrument's readings since the last passed calibration date

blocks.zh: 若有批次在此期間放行，啟動回顧性偏差調查 (retrospective deviation)
blocks.en: If batches were released during this period, initiate a retrospective deviation investigation

blocks.zh: 確認是設備問題還是程序問題，並採取 CAPA
blocks.en: Determine whether the cause is an equipment problem or a procedural problem, and take CAPA

blocks.zh: 這個流程的嚴謹度直接體現了 GMP 對於量測系統管控的要求。
blocks.en: The rigor of this process directly reflects the GMP requirements for control of measurement systems.

blocks.zh: 關鍵氣體系統儀表校正矩陣示例
blocks.en: Example Calibration Matrix for Critical Gas System Instruments

blocks.zh:
儀表類型          重要性分類    校正頻率    校正標準
露點感應器(POU)   產品關鍵      6個月       NIST 可追溯基準
O₂分析儀(N₂系統) 產品關鍵      6個月       認證標準氣體
系統壓力傳送器    製程關鍵      12個月      校正氣壓計
流量計(用量監控)  製程關鍵      12個月      NIST 可追溯流量標準
壓縮機出口壓力錶  非關鍵        24個月      目視+功能檢查
工廠用壓力錶      非關鍵        24個月      比對法
blocks.en:
Instrument type              Criticality      Frequency   Calibration standard
Dew point sensor (POU)       Product critical 6 months    NIST-traceable reference
O₂ analyzer (N₂ system)      Product critical 6 months    Certified standard gas
System pressure transmitter  Process critical 12 months   Calibrated pressure gauge
Flow meter (usage monitoring) Process critical 12 months  NIST-traceable flow standard
Compressor outlet pressure gauge Non-critical 24 months   Visual + functional check
Plant pressure gauge         Non-critical     24 months   Comparison method

blocks.zh: 若氮氣系統的 O₂ 分析儀在校正時發現讀值偏低 0.2%（實際 O₂ 濃度比顯示值高），這對於過去 3 個月的氮氣品質放行記錄有什麼影響？
blocks.en: If, during calibration, the O₂ analyzer of a nitrogen system is found to read 0.2% low (the actual O₂ concentration is higher than displayed), what is the impact on the nitrogen quality release records of the past 3 months?

blocks.zh: 設備供應商建議每 12 個月校正一次露點感應器，但風險評估將其評為「產品關鍵」，你應該採用哪個頻率？理由為何？
blocks.en: The equipment supplier recommends calibrating the dew point sensor every 12 months, but the risk assessment rates it "product critical". Which frequency should you adopt, and why?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary — Chapters 7–9
blocks.en: Section Summary — Chapters 7-9

blocks.zh: Ch7 QRM 原則：品質風險管理應貫穿氣體系統整個生命週期，從 URS 到日常維護。風險評估的三步驟（識別→分析→評估）是 FMEA 的核心架構，ICH Q9 是基礎法規參考。
blocks.en: Ch7 QRM principles: Quality risk management should span the entire life cycle of the gas system, from URS to routine maintenance. The three-step risk assessment (identification, analysis, evaluation) is the core structure of FMEA, and ICH Q9 is the foundational regulatory reference.

blocks.zh: Ch7 氣體系統常見失效模式：壓縮機失效、過濾器堵塞、水分突破、O₂ 滲入 N₂、氣體混用——每個都需要有對應的設計控制或程序控制作為風險降低措施。
blocks.en: Ch7 Common failure modes of gas systems: compressor failure, filter blockage, moisture breakthrough, O₂ ingress into N₂, and gas mix-up. Each needs a corresponding design control or procedural control as a risk reduction measure.

blocks.zh: Ch8 ETOP 是確效的橋樑：工程移交文件包（施工管理者、安裝承包商、試運行三個部分）是 IQ 確效的主要數據來源，P&ID 不一致和校正記錄缺漏是最常見的稽核發現。
blocks.en: Ch8 The ETOP is the bridge to qualification: The engineering turnover package (with its three parts: construction manager, installation contractor and commissioning) is the main data source for IQ; inconsistent P&IDs and missing calibration records are the most common audit findings.

blocks.zh: Ch8 試運行 vs 確效：試運行由工程主導（不需 QA 事前核准），確效由品保主導（需要事前核准的協議書）。ASTM E2500 框架允許充分借用試運行數據支援確效，避免重複工作。
blocks.en: Ch8 Commissioning vs qualification: Commissioning is led by engineering (no QA pre-approval required); qualification is led by QA (requires a pre-approved protocol). The ASTM E2500 framework allows commissioning data to be fully leveraged to support qualification, avoiding duplicate work.

blocks.zh: Ch8 性能測試三連抽：每個 POU 至少三次連續採樣是最低統計要求。確效摘要報告批准後，系統進入正式 QA 變更管控體系。
blocks.en: Ch8 The three-sample performance test: At least three consecutive samples at each POU is the minimum statistical requirement. After approval of the qualification summary report, the system enters the formal QA change control system.

blocks.zh: Ch9 過濾器換濾管控：POU 過濾器規格變更須通過正式 Change Control；不應單獨依賴差壓作為換濾指標；POU 過濾器是 GMP 與非 GMP 氣體的關鍵屏障。
blocks.en: Ch9 Filter change control: Changes to POU filter specifications must go through formal change control; do not rely on differential pressure alone as the filter change indicator; POU filters are the critical barrier between GMP and non-GMP gases.

blocks.zh: Ch9 校正策略風險分層：校正頻率必須與儀表對 CQA 的影響成比例——露點感應器與 O₂ 分析儀屬「產品關鍵」，應採用最嚴格的校正計畫和失敗影響評估程序。
blocks.en: Ch9 Risk-tiered calibration strategy: Calibration frequency must be proportional to the instrument's impact on CQAs. Dew point sensors and O₂ analyzers are "product critical" and should have the strictest calibration program and failure impact assessment procedure.
